Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle moved to the right to
change lanes and made contact with the right side of a vehicle operated by Driver 2, which was already in the right
lane. Driver 1 stated that the contact was a glancing sideswipe that pushed both vehicles slightly apart. Driver 1
reported neck and back strain and was evaluated at the scene. The reported injuries are consistent in type and force
with a lateral impact of this kind. A Passenger was also present in Driver 2's vehicle, and Driver 2 reported no injury.
Scene photographs show damage to the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle and the left front fender of Driver
2's vehicle, which are consistent with the account given. No independent witnesses were identified. Some of the
damage visible in the photographs may be older or may not be related to this contact, and this has not been resolved.
Driver 1's seating position at the moment of impact was not clearly established during the interview. No prior damage
to Dirver 1's vehicle is known to the reporting officer. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the
vehicle.
